unit.title: When our memories disagree
canDo: Reconstruct an agreement from full context and chronology
Separate a specific error from sweeping frequency claims
Repair a relationship with distinct responsibilities and bounded commitments

grammar.purpose: Keep a concession without cancelling a feeling
grammar.explanation: 虽 is compact and common in organised narration; 虽然 is fuller. The second clause can preserve a consequence or qualification despite the first.

examples.zh: 虽已看清消息，但等待时的难受还在。
examples.py: suī yǐ kàn qīng xiāo xī , dàn děng dài shí de nán shòu hái zài .
examples.en: Although the message is clear now, the hurt from waiting remains.

examples.zh: 虽已到场，却还没有听完她的解释。
examples.py: suī yǐ dào chǎng , què hái méi yǒu tīng wán tā de jiě shì .
examples.en: Although present, he has not heard her full explanation.

commonMistakes.wrong: 虽已看清消息，所以她必须完全没感觉。
commonMistakes.right: 虽已看清消息，但等待时的难受还在。
commonMistakes.why: Factual clarification does not logically erase a feeling.

grammar.purpose: Maintain a limit under a hypothetical condition
grammar.explanation: 就算 introduces an assumed or extreme case; 也 keeps a claim or requirement. It does not certify that the assumed event occurred.

examples.zh: 就算这次迟了，也不能直接说每次都迟。
examples.py: jiù suàn zhè cì chí le , yě bù néng zhí jiē shuō měi cì dōu chí .
examples.en: Even if late this time, that does not establish lateness every time.

examples.zh: 就算你记得很清楚，也可以再确认。
examples.py: jiù suàn nǐ jì de hěn qīng chǔ , yě kě yǐ zài què rèn .
examples.en: Even if you remember clearly, you can check again.

commonMistakes.wrong: 就算这次迟了，说明以前每次都迟。
commonMistakes.right: 就算这次迟了，也不能直接说每次都迟。
commonMistakes.why: A hypothetical concession does not establish every earlier event.

grammar.purpose: Describe an outcome contrary to the intended direction
grammar.explanation: The intended or expected outcome comes from context. The result after 反而 contrasts with it.

examples.zh: 那句解释不但没有让她放心，反而让她更生气。
examples.py: nà jù jiě shì bù dàn méi yǒu ràng tā fàng xīn , fǎn ér ràng tā gèng shēng qì .
examples.en: That explanation not only failed to reassure her but upset her further.

examples.zh: 反复追问不但没有说清，反而又吵起来了。
examples.py: fǎn fù zhuī wèn bù dàn méi yǒu shuō qīng , fǎn ér yòu chǎo qǐ lái le .
examples.en: Repeated questioning not only failed to clarify but restarted the argument.

commonMistakes.wrong: 那句解释让她放心，反而完全符合我原来的期待。
commonMistakes.right: 那句解释不但没有让她放心，反而让她更生气。
commonMistakes.why: Here the actual result contrasts with attempted reassurance.

grammar.explanation: The reply accepts a relevant point, often after a different emphasis. It need not accept every earlier claim.

examples.zh: 你两点半到了，也没解决前面的等待。那倒也是。
examples.py: nǐ liǎng diǎn bàn dào le , yě méi jiě jué qián miàn de děng dài . nà dào yě shì .
examples.en: Arriving at 2:30 doesn’t remove the waiting. That is true.

examples.zh: 先确认到场，不只写下班。那倒也是。
examples.py: xiān què rèn dào chǎng , bù zhǐ xiě xià bān . nà dào yě shì .
examples.en: Confirm arrival, not just finishing work. Fair point.

commonMistakes.wrong: 那倒也是，所以我同意你说的每一件事。
commonMistakes.right: 那倒也是，我们先把时间写清。
commonMistakes.why: Acknowledging this point does not imply blanket agreement.

grammar.purpose: Accept a choice with a concessive or resigned tone
grammar.explanation: The repeated element accepts a proposal, sometimes reluctantly. Delivery and context matter; it is not a guarantee of enthusiasm.

examples.zh: 改就改吧，先把新的时间说清。
examples.py: gǎi jiù gǎi ba , xiān bǎ xīn de shí jiān shuō qīng .
examples.en: Fine, change it; tell me the new time first.

examples.zh: 等就等吧，不过给我一个大概时间。
examples.py: děng jiù děng ba , bù guò gěi wǒ yī gè dà gài shí jiān .
examples.en: Fine, I’ll wait, but give me an approximate time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 等就等吧，所以不用告诉我大概时间。
commonMistakes.right: 等就等吧，不过给我一个大概时间。
commonMistakes.why: Acceptance can keep a concrete condition.

grammar.purpose: Follow a change of state and recovered memory
grammar.explanation: 下来 can mark settling into a calmer state; 起来 can mark recollection becoming available. These extended uses are not literal movement down or up.

examples.zh: 看完消息，我慢慢平静下来。
examples.py: kàn wán xiāo xī , wǒ màn màn píng jìng xià lái .
examples.en: After checking the message I gradually calmed down.

examples.zh: 我想起来了，你说的是下班，不是到场。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái le , nǐ shuō de shì xià bān , bù shì dào chǎng .
examples.en: I remember now: you meant finishing work, not arrival.

commonMistakes.wrong: 平静下来说明他从椅子上走到楼下。
commonMistakes.right: 看完消息，我慢慢平静下来。
commonMistakes.why: The complement describes a state change, not a physical route.

dialogue.title: 我们记得不一样
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你说两点到，我等了半小时。
lines.py: nǐ shuō liǎng diǎn dào , wǒ děng le bàn xiǎo shí .
lines.en: You said you’d arrive at two. I waited half an hour.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我说的是两点下班，半小时过去，你不是说好了吗？
lines.py: wǒ shuō de shì liǎng diǎn xià bān , bàn xiǎo shí guò qù , nǐ bù shì shuō hǎo le ma ?
lines.en: I said I finished work at two and would take half an hour. Didn’t you agree?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我记得你说两点，所以先到了。
lines.py: wǒ jì de nǐ shuō liǎng diǎn , suǒ yǐ xiān dào le .
lines.en: I remember two, so I came first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我们看看昨天的消息，别先说谁一定记错。
lines.py: wǒ men kàn kàn zuó tiān de xiāo xī , bié xiān shuō shéi yí dìng jì cuò .
lines.en: Let’s check yesterday’s messages before deciding who must be wrong.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这里是我问明天下午两点到小厅拍照，对吧？
lines.py: zhè lǐ shì wǒ wèn míng tiān xià wǔ liǎng diǎn dào xiǎo tīng pāi zhào , duì ba ?
lines.en: Here I asked about photos at the hall at two tomorrow, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。下面我说两点下班，大概两点半到，可以吗。
lines.py: duì . xià miàn wǒ shuō liǎng diǎn xià bān , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , kě yǐ ma .
lines.en: Right. Below that I said finish at two, arrive about 2:30, would that work?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 然后我回好，到时联系。
lines.py: rán hòu wǒ huí hǎo , dào shí lián xì .
lines.en: Then I replied okay, we’ll contact each other then.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 所以我们没有把最后到场时间再写一遍。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ men méi yǒu bǎ zuì hòu dào chǎng shí jiān zài xiě yī biàn .
lines.en: So we didn’t write the final arrival time again.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这次我没看完整，抱歉。不过我两点五分问你，也没回复。
lines.py: zhè cì wǒ méi kàn wán zhěng , bào qiàn . bù guò wǒ liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn wèn nǐ , yě méi huí fù .
lines.en: Sorry, I didn’t read it all. But I messaged at five past and got no reply.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我那时在走，十二分停下才回，估计两点半。
lines.py: wǒ nà shí zài zǒu , shí èr fēn tíng xià cái huí , gū jì liǎng diǎn bàn .
lines.en: I was walking; I stopped at twelve past to reply, estimating 2:30.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我不知道你在路上，觉得你根本忘了。
lines.py: wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ zài lù shàng , jué de nǐ gēn běn wàng le .
lines.en: I didn’t know you were on the way and thought you’d forgotten entirely.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可你说每次都迟到，我听了也生气。
lines.py: kě nǐ shuō měi cì dōu chí dào , wǒ tīng le yě shēng qì .
lines.en: But saying I’m late every time upset me too.

reading.title: 我们记得不一样
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 周五晚上六点，我问陈宇第二天下午能不能两点到小厅，一起给活动拍照。他十分钟以后回复，说两点才能下班，从公司过去要半小时，大概两点半到，问可不可以。我当时还在收东西，只看见前面两点，又觉得他已经答应，就回了好，到时联系。后来我把日历记成两点，没有再看后面那一段。
lines.py: zhōu wǔ wǎn shang liù diǎn , wǒ wèn chén yǔ dì èr tiān xià wǔ néng bù néng liǎng diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , yì qǐ gěi huó dòng pāi zhào . tā shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu huí fù , shuō liǎng diǎn cái néng xià bān , cóng gōng sī guò qù yào bàn xiǎo shí , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , wèn kě bù kě yǐ . wǒ dāng shí hái zài shōu dōng xi , zhǐ kàn jiàn qián miàn liǎng diǎn , yòu jué de tā yǐ jīng dā yìng , jiù huí le hǎo , dào shí lián xì . hòu lái wǒ bǎ rì lì jì chéng liǎng diǎn , méi yǒu zài kàn hòu miàn nà yī duàn .
lines.en: At six Friday evening I asked Chen Yu about arriving at the hall at two Saturday to take activity photos. Ten minutes later he said he finished work at two, needed half an hour and expected about 2:30, asking whether that worked. While packing I noticed two and took it as acceptance, replied okay and entered two without rereading.

lines.zh: 周六我特意提前到，想先把桌子和几件要拍的东西摆好。两点到了，他没来。两点五分我发消息问怎么还没到，等了几分钟没答复。我不知道他已经在走路，脑子里先想到的是他忘记了。两点十二分，他说在路上，估计两点半；我回了一句，你每次都迟到。这句话发出去以后，我还觉得自己是在说实话。
lines.py: zhōu liù wǒ tè yì tí qián dào , xiǎng xiān bǎ zhuō zi hé jǐ jiàn yào pāi de dōng xi bǎi hǎo . liǎng diǎn dào le , tā méi lái . liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn wǒ fā xiāo xī wèn zěn me hái méi dào , děng le jǐ fēn zhōng méi dá fù . wǒ bù zhī dào tā yǐ jīng zài zǒu lù , nǎo zi lǐ xiān xiǎng dào de shì tā wàng jì le . liǎng diǎn shí èr fēn , tā shuō zài lù shàng , gū jì liǎng diǎn bàn ; wǒ huí le yī jù , nǐ měi cì dōu chí dào . zhè jù huà fā chū qù yǐ hòu , wǒ hái jué de zì jǐ shì zài shuō shí huà .
lines.en: I came early Saturday to prepare. At two he was absent; my 2:05 message initially went unanswered. Not knowing he was walking, I assumed forgetfulness. At 2:12 he estimated arrival at 2:30. I sent “you’re late every time,” then felt it was simply truthful.

lines.zh: 他两点半到了，第一句不是道歉，而是说自己从没答应两点到。我听着仿佛他只想把所有事情都推给我，没让他讲完，就再提自己已经等了半小时。他也说我从没认真看消息。两个从没、每次，把这一天下午的等待变成了对所有过去的判断；可是我们当时谁都没有查看以前究竟发生多少次。
lines.py: tā liǎng diǎn bàn dào le , dì yī jù bù shì dào qiàn , ér shì shuō zì jǐ cóng méi dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào . wǒ tīng zhe fǎng fú tā zhǐ xiǎng bǎ suǒ yǒu shì qíng dōu tuī gěi wǒ , méi ràng tā jiǎng wán , jiù zài tí zì jǐ yǐ jīng děng le bàn xiǎo shí . tā yě shuō wǒ cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn xiāo xī . liǎng gè cóng méi , měi cì , bǎ zhè yī tiān xià wǔ de děng dài biàn chéng le duì suǒ yǒu guò qù de pàn duàn ; kě shì wǒ men dāng shí shéi dōu méi yǒu chá kàn yǐ qián jiū jìng fā shēng duō shao cì .
lines.en: At 2:30 he said he’d never promised two rather than opening with an apology. It felt like shifting everything to me, and we interrupted each other with claims that I never read carefully and he was always late, without checking earlier occasions.

lines.zh: 后来我们挨着桌子坐，把手机放在中间。我先找到自己的邀请，他再把下面那条完整回复指给我看。两点下班、半小时过去、大概两点半到，都在那条里。我承认没有看完整；他也说好、到时联系可以再问一句，确认最后到场的时间，而不是假定我们已经完全一样。记录没有消除所有难受，却让我们不再围着两个不同的记忆打转。
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ men āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhōng jiān . wǒ xiān zhǎo dào zì jǐ de yāo qǐng , tā zài bǎ xià miàn nà tiáo wán zhěng huí fù zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn . liǎng diǎn xià bān , bàn xiǎo shí guò qù , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , dōu zài nà tiáo lǐ . wǒ chéng rèn méi yǒu kàn wán zhěng ; tā yě shuō hǎo , dào shí lián xì kě yǐ zài wèn yī jù , què rèn zuì hòu dào chǎng de shí jiān , ér bù shì jiǎ dìng wǒ men yǐ jīng wán quán yī yàng . jì lù méi yǒu xiāo chú suǒ yǒu nán shòu , què ràng wǒ men bù zài wéi zhe liǎng gè bù tóng de jì yì dǎ zhuǎn .
lines.en: Sitting beside the table, we checked the full exchange together. The reply stated finishing at two, half-hour travel and about 2:30 arrival. I admitted missing it; he recognised that a clearer confirmation could have checked the shared arrival time. The record didn’t erase hurt, but ended circling around different recollections.

lines.zh: 我还问，两点五分不回复，是不是因为他不愿意理我。他说当时在走路，十二分停下来才看手机。我亲眼见到的是他两点半到，不是前面每分钟在哪里，所以这段我没有自己的观察。他解释自己的经过，我可以继续问不清楚的地方，却不能只因为自己没看到，就说这个经过肯定不存在。暂时相信和亲眼证实，也不必叫作同一件事。
lines.py: wǒ hái wèn , liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn bù huí fù , shì bú shì yīn wèi tā bù yuàn yì lǐ wǒ . tā shuō dāng shí zài zǒu lù , shí èr fēn tíng xià lái cái kàn shǒu jī . wǒ qīn yǎn jiàn dào de shì tā liǎng diǎn bàn dào , bù shì qián miàn měi fēn zhōng zài nǎ lǐ , suǒ yǐ zhè duàn wǒ méi yǒu zì jǐ de guān chá . tā jiě shì zì jǐ de jīng guò , wǒ kě yǐ jì xù wèn bù qīng chǔ de dì fāng , què bù néng zhǐ yīn wèi zì jǐ méi kàn dào , jiù shuō zhè gè jīng guò kěn dìng bù cún zài . zàn shí xiāng xìn hé qīn yǎn zhèng shí , yě bù bì jiào zuò tóng yī jiàn shì .
lines.en: He explained the delayed reply as walking until stopping at 2:12. I had seen his arrival, not each earlier minute. I could ask about uncertainties but couldn’t deny an account solely because I hadn’t witnessed it. Accepting an account and firsthand verification remain different.

lines.zh: 他问我最不舒服的是哪一点。我说表面上是等半小时，实际还觉得只有自己认真准备，另一个人没把约定放在心上。他没有用两点半到了这一点，让我立刻觉得等待不算。他说，下班和到场确实不同，他没有故意忘记，不过以后可以把到场写得更清楚。如果真的改了，就给新的估计，不只说快了快了。
lines.py: tā wèn wǒ zuì bù shū fú de shì nǎ yī diǎn . wǒ shuō biǎo miàn shàng shì děng bàn xiǎo shí , shí jì hái jué de zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi , lìng yī gè rén méi bǎ yuē dìng fàng zài xīn shàng . tā méi yǒu yòng liǎng diǎn bàn dào le zhè yī diǎn , ràng wǒ lì kè jué de děng dài bù suàn . tā shuō , xià bān hé dào chǎng què shí bù tóng , tā méi yǒu gù yì wàng jì , bù guò yǐ hòu kě yǐ bǎ dào chǎng xiě de gèng qīng chǔ . rú guǒ zhēn de gǎi le , jiù gěi xīn de gū jì , bù zhǐ shuō kuài le kuài le .
lines.en: Waiting mattered alongside feeling alone in taking preparation seriously. He didn’t treat arrival at 2:30 as erasing that. He distinguished finishing work and arrival, denied intentional forgetting and offered clearer future arrival and revised estimates instead of “soon.”

lines.zh: 我向他道歉的是没看完整，以及把这次说成每次。他向我道歉的是从没认真看那句，还有没听完就打断。我们没有把道歉写成一个人承认全部都错，另一个人全部都对。两个人可以负责不同的部分；看到一条记录以后，也不需要为了保持生气，就继续坚持里面没有写过的时间。
lines.py: wǒ xiàng tā dào qiàn de shì méi kàn wán zhěng , yǐ jí bǎ zhè cì shuō chéng měi cì . tā xiàng wǒ dào qiàn de shì cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn nà jù , hái yǒu méi tīng wán jiù dǎ duàn . wǒ men méi yǒu bǎ dào qiàn xiě chéng yī gè rén chéng rèn quán bù dōu cuò , lìng yī gè rén quán bù dōu duì . liǎng gè rén kě yǐ fù zé bù tóng de bù fèn ; kàn dào yī tiáo jì lù yǐ hòu , yě bù xū yào wèi le bǎo chí shēng qì , jiù jì xù jiān chí lǐ miàn méi yǒu xiě guò de shí jiān .
lines.en: I apologised for incomplete reading and overgeneralisation; he apologised for “never reading carefully” and interrupting. Each took responsibility for different parts rather than one person accepting all fault. The record allowed me to revise a claim without preserving it merely to remain angry.

lines.zh: 下一次约的是周四六点到小厅，我们把到场地点和时间重新写了一遍，并约五点半确认。我把六点圈起来，陈宇问这回写的是到场，不是下班吧。我说对，又在旁边写上小厅。真有急事就打电话，不方便接时稍后回复。他打开包给我看，相机和充电线已经放好了，周四我带纸和笔，到了就能开始。
lines.py: xià yī cì yuē de shì zhōu sì liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǒ men bǎ dào chǎng dì diǎn hé shí jiān chóng xīn xiě le yī biàn , bìng yuē wǔ diǎn bàn què rèn . wǒ bǎ liù diǎn quān qǐ lái , chén yǔ wèn zhè huí xiě de shì dào chǎng , bù shì xià bān ba . wǒ shuō duì , yòu zài páng biān xiě shàng xiǎo tīng . zhēn yǒu jí shì jiù dǎ diàn huà , bù fāng biàn jiē shí shāo hòu huí fù . tā dǎ kāi bāo gěi wǒ kàn , xiàng jī hé chōng diàn xiàn yǐ jīng fàng hǎo le , zhōu sì wǒ dài zhǐ hé bǐ , dào le jiù néng kāi shǐ .
lines.en: Next time was Thursday at six at the hall, with confirmation at 5:30. I circled six. Arrival, not leaving work? Chen Yu asked. Yes, I said, and added the hall beside it. We'd call about anything urgent and reply later if unable to answer. He showed me the camera and cable in his bag; I'd bring paper and a pen on Thursday.

lines.zh: 说完以后，我仍然有一点不想聊天，就先把桌上的东西摆好。他没有再追着问我生不生气，拿起相机，让我站到窗边试一下光。我说那里太亮，他把椅子挪到另一边，自己差点坐进照片里。我忍不住笑了一下，又想起刚才在门口等的那半小时。等拍完收东西时，心里才比来时轻了一点。
lines.py: shuō wán yǐ hòu , wǒ réng rán yǒu yī diǎn bù xiǎng liáo tiān , jiù xiān bǎ zhuō shàng de dōng xi bǎi hǎo . tā méi yǒu zài zhuī zhe wèn wǒ shēng bù shēng qì , ná qǐ xiàng jī , ràng wǒ zhàn dào chuāng biān shì yī xià guāng . wǒ shuō nà lǐ tài liàng , tā bǎ yǐ zi nuó dào lìng yī biān , zì jǐ chà diǎn zuò jìn zhào piān lǐ . wǒ rěn bú zhù xiào le yī xià , yòu xiǎng qǐ gāng cái zài mén kǒu děng de nà bàn xiǎo shí . děng pāi wán shōu dōng xi shí , xīn lǐ cái bǐ lái shí qīng le yī diǎn .
lines.en: I still didn't feel like talking and began arranging the things on the table. He stopped asking whether I was angry and tested the light by the window. Too bright, I said. Moving the chair, he nearly sat in the photograph himself, and I couldn't help laughing—though I still remembered the half-hour wait. Only after packing up did I feel a little lighter.

lines.zh: 回家后我再打开日历，两点那个数字还是自己亲手写的。我往下补了两点下班、两点半到，才觉得这一天终于和聊天记录对上。陈宇发来一张下午的照片，问选哪张，我说等我明天再看，现在先把周四的时间记好。他回了六点到小厅，我又回他六点到，不是六点出门，两个人这才没有再解释。
lines.py: huí jiā hòu wǒ zài dǎ kāi rì lì , liǎng diǎn nà gè shù zì hái shi zì jǐ qīn shǒu xiě de . wǒ wǎng xià bǔ le liǎng diǎn xià bān , liǎng diǎn bàn dào , cái jué de zhè yī tiān zhōng yú hé liáo tiān jì lù duì shàng . chén yǔ fā lái yī zhāng xià wǔ de zhào piān , wèn xuǎn nǎ zhāng , wǒ shuō děng wǒ míng tiān zài kàn , xiàn zài xiān bǎ zhōu sì de shí jiān jì hǎo . tā huí le liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǒ yòu huí tā liù diǎn dào , bù shì liù diǎn chū mén , liǎng gè rén zhè cái méi yǒu zài jiě shì .
lines.en: At home, the two in my calendar was still the number I'd written. Adding two for leaving work and 2:30 for arrival finally made it match the messages. Chen Yu sent a photograph and asked which to choose. I'd look tomorrow; first I'd record Thursday. Six at the hall, he replied. Six for arrival, not departure, I added. At last neither of us needed another explanation.

lines.zh: 周六我【特意】提前到，想先把桌子和几件要拍的东西摆好。两点到了，他没来。两点五分我发消息问怎么还没到，等了几分钟没答复。我不知道他已经在走路，脑子里先想到的是他忘记了。两点十二分，他说在路上，估计两点半；我回了一句，你每次都迟到。这句话发出去以后，我还觉得自己是在说实话。
lines.py: zhōu liù wǒ tè yì tí qián dào , xiǎng xiān bǎ zhuō zi hé jǐ jiàn yào pāi de dōng xi bǎi hǎo . liǎng diǎn dào le , tā méi lái . liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn wǒ fā xiāo xī wèn zěn me hái méi dào , děng le jǐ fēn zhōng méi dá fù . wǒ bù zhī dào tā yǐ jīng zài zǒu lù , nǎo zi lǐ xiān xiǎng dào de shì tā wàng jì le . liǎng diǎn shí èr fēn , tā shuō zài lù shàng , gū jì liǎng diǎn bàn ; wǒ huí le yī jù , nǐ měi cì dōu chí dào . zhè jù huà fā chū qù yǐ hòu , wǒ hái jué de zì jǐ shì zài shuō shí huà .
lines.en: I came early Saturday to prepare. At two he was absent; my 2:05 message initially went unanswered. Not knowing he was walking, I assumed forgetfulness. At 2:12 he estimated arrival at 2:30. I sent “you’re late every time,” then felt it was simply truthful.

lines.zh: 他两点半到了，第一句不是【道歉】，而是说自己从没答应两点到。我听着仿佛他只想把所有事情都推给我，没让他讲完，就再提自己已经等了半小时。他也说我从没认真看消息。两个从没、每次，把这一天下午的等待变成了对所有过去的判断；可是我们当时谁都没有查看以前究竟发生多少次。
lines.py: tā liǎng diǎn bàn dào le , dì yī jù bù shì dào qiàn , ér shì shuō zì jǐ cóng méi dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào . wǒ tīng zhe fǎng fú tā zhǐ xiǎng bǎ suǒ yǒu shì qíng dōu tuī gěi wǒ , méi ràng tā jiǎng wán , jiù zài tí zì jǐ yǐ jīng děng le bàn xiǎo shí . tā yě shuō wǒ cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn xiāo xī . liǎng gè cóng méi , měi cì , bǎ zhè yī tiān xià wǔ de děng dài biàn chéng le duì suǒ yǒu guò qù de pàn duàn ; kě shì wǒ men dāng shí shéi dōu méi yǒu chá kàn yǐ qián jiū jìng fā shēng duō shao cì .
lines.en: At 2:30 he said he’d never promised two rather than opening with an apology. It felt like shifting everything to me, and we interrupted each other with claims that I never read carefully and he was always late, without checking earlier occasions.

lines.zh: 后来我们挨着桌子坐，把手机放在中间。我先找到自己的邀请，他再把下面那条完整回复指给我看。两点下班、半小时过去、大概两点半到，都在那条里。我承认没有看完整；他也说好、到时联系可以再问一句，确认最后到场的时间，而不是假定我们已经完全一样。记录没有消除所有难受，却让我们【不再】围着两个不同的记忆打转。
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ men āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhōng jiān . wǒ xiān zhǎo dào zì jǐ de yāo qǐng , tā zài bǎ xià miàn nà tiáo wán zhěng huí fù zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn . liǎng diǎn xià bān , bàn xiǎo shí guò qù , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , dōu zài nà tiáo lǐ . wǒ chéng rèn méi yǒu kàn wán zhěng ; tā yě shuō hǎo , dào shí lián xì kě yǐ zài wèn yī jù , què rèn zuì hòu dào chǎng de shí jiān , ér bù shì jiǎ dìng wǒ men yǐ jīng wán quán yī yàng . jì lù méi yǒu xiāo chú suǒ yǒu nán shòu , què ràng wǒ men bù zài wéi zhe liǎng gè bù tóng de jì yì dǎ zhuǎn .
lines.en: Sitting beside the table, we checked the full exchange together. The reply stated finishing at two, half-hour travel and about 2:30 arrival. I admitted missing it; he recognised that a clearer confirmation could have checked the shared arrival time. The record didn’t erase hurt, but ended circling around different recollections.

extraReadings.title: Let me finish this part
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你还在生气吗？
lines.py: nǐ hái zài shēng qì ma ?
lines.en: Are you still upset?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有一点，不过想先说完。
lines.py: yǒu yī diǎn , bù guò xiǎng xiān shuō wán .
lines.en: A little, but I want to finish talking first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我先不解释。
lines.py: nà wǒ xiān bù jiě shì .
lines.en: Then I’ll hold off explaining.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你这么说，又好像等着找机会解释。
lines.py: nǐ zhè me shuō , yòu hǎo xiàng děng zhe zhǎo jī huì jiě shì .
lines.en: That still sounds like waiting for a chance to explain.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 被你听出来了。我先听，真的。
lines.py: bèi nǐ tīng chū lái le . wǒ xiān tīng , zhēn de .
lines.en: You caught it. I will listen first, honestly.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我不是要你永远不能说。
lines.py: wǒ bù shì yào nǐ yǒng yuǎn bù néng shuō .
lines.en: I don’t mean you can never speak.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 是让我不要抢着说。
lines.py: shì ràng wǒ bú yào qiǎng zhe shuō .
lines.en: You mean don’t rush to interrupt.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。让我讲完这一段。
lines.py: duì . ràng wǒ jiǎng wán zhè yī duàn .
lines.en: Right. Let me finish this part.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我把手机放下来。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng xià lái .
lines.en: Okay, I’ll put my phone down.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 手机可以一起看，别一边看一边打断。
lines.py: shǒu jī kě yǐ yì qǐ kàn , bié yī biān kàn yī biān dǎ duàn .
lines.en: We can check the phone together; just don’t interrupt while looking.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我挨着桌子坐，等你说完。
lines.py: nà wǒ āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , děng nǐ shuō wán .
lines.en: Then I’ll sit by the table and wait until you finish.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这次等我说完，不算迟到啊。
lines.py: zhè cì děng wǒ shuō wán , bù suàn chí dào a .
lines.en: This time, waiting needn’t count as being late.
lines.speaker: b

choices: No interruption until this part is finished
The other person must never speak again
No shared checking of the phone
questions.answer: No interruption until this part is finished

questions.q: What does the final waiting remark do?
choices: Lightly distinguishes listening from arrival lateness
Restores an accusation about every past event
Guarantees all disagreement has disappeared
questions.answer: Lightly distinguishes listening from arrival lateness

extraReadings.title: When our memories disagree: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 我们记得不一样 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 我承诺提前确认，不承诺以后永远不会有变化。
lines.py: wǒ chéng nuò tí qián què rèn , bù chéng nuò yǐ hòu yǒng yuǎn bù huì yǒu biàn huà .
lines.en: I promise to confirm ahead, not that nothing will ever change.

lines.zh: 这个承诺只包括周四那一次。
lines.py: zhè gè chéng nuò zhǐ bāo kuò zhōu sì nà yī cì .
lines.en: This promise covers only that Thursday.

lines.zh: 我要为刚才说得太重道歉。
lines.py: wǒ yào wèi gāng cái shuō de tài zhòng dào qiàn .
lines.en: I need to apologise for speaking too harshly.

lines.zh: 她道歉以后，也改了下一次的安排。
lines.py: tā dào qiàn yǐ hòu , yě gǎi le xià yī cì de ān pái .
lines.en: After apologising she changed the next arrangement too.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我刚才没有看完整条消息。
lines.py: bào qiàn , wǒ gāng cái méi yǒu kàn wán zhěng tiáo xiāo xī .
lines.en: Sorry, I didn’t read the whole message.

lines.zh: 今天不便接电话，抱歉。
lines.py: jīn tiān bù biàn jiē diàn huà , bào qiàn .
lines.en: Sorry, it isn’t convenient to take a call today.

lines.zh: 我把两点下班当作两点到场了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ liǎng diǎn xià bān dàng zuò liǎng diǎn dào chǎng le .
lines.en: I took finishing work at two to mean arriving at two.

lines.zh: 不要把一次沉默当作最后的答复。
lines.py: bú yào bǎ yī cì chén mò dàng zuò zuì hòu de dá fù .
lines.en: Don’t treat one silence as the final answer.

lines.zh: 我先让她说完，没有马上打断。
lines.py: wǒ xiān ràng tā shuō wán , méi yǒu mǎ shàng dǎ duàn .
lines.en: I let her finish without interrupting immediately.

lines.zh: 门外的声音打断了我们的谈话。
lines.py: mén wài de shēng yīn dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán huà .
lines.en: The sound outside interrupted our conversation.

lines.zh: 我错过的是两点一起准备，不是整个下午。
lines.py: wǒ cuò guò de shì liǎng diǎn yì qǐ zhǔn bèi , bù shì zhěng gè xià wǔ .
lines.en: I missed preparing together at two, not the whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 她错过一班车，后来坐了下一班。
lines.py: tā cuò guò yī bān chē , hòu lái zuò le xià yī bān .
lines.en: She missed one bus, then took the next.

lines.zh: 这次没说清，不至于说明每次都故意迟到。
lines.py: zhè cì méi shuō qīng , bù zhì yú shuō míng měi cì dōu gù yì chí dào .
lines.en: This unclear arrangement doesn’t establish deliberate lateness every time.

lines.zh: 少带一本书，不至于完全没法参加。
lines.py: shǎo dài yī běn shū , bù zhì yú wán quán méi fǎ cān jiā .
lines.en: One fewer book doesn’t make participation entirely impossible.

lines.zh: 他说我从不看消息，可他只提了这一次。
lines.py: tā shuō wǒ cóng bù kàn xiāo xī , kě tā zhǐ tí le zhè yī cì .
lines.en: He said I never read messages, but cited only this occasion.

lines.zh: 她从不把借来的书留给别人。
lines.py: tā cóng bù bǎ jiè lái de shū liú gěi bié ren .
lines.en: She never passes borrowed books to someone else.

lines.zh: 我从没答应两点到，只说两点下班。
lines.py: wǒ cóng méi dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào , zhǐ shuō liǎng diǎn xià bān .
lines.en: I never promised to arrive at two, only to finish work then.

lines.zh: 我从没去过那个小厅。
lines.py: wǒ cóng méi qù guò nà gè xiǎo tīng .
lines.en: I have never been to that hall.

lines.zh: 我想请你原谅那句太重的话。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ yuán liàng nà jù tài zhòng de huà .
lines.en: I want to ask you to forgive that harsh remark.

lines.zh: 她说愿意原谅，不代表马上忘记。
lines.py: tā shuō yuàn yì yuán liàng , bù dài biǎo mǎ shàng wàng jì .
lines.en: She says she is willing to forgive; that doesn’t mean instantly forgetting.

lines.zh: 我们太依赖自己记得的时间，没有再确认。
lines.py: wǒ men tài yī lài zì jǐ jì de de shí jiān , méi yǒu zài què rèn .
lines.en: We relied too much on remembered times without checking again.

lines.zh: 这个办法依赖两个人都看到通知。
lines.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ yī lài liǎng gè rén dōu kàn dào tōng zhī .
lines.en: This approach depends on both people seeing the notice.

lines.zh: 你迟一点答复，是工作还没结束的缘故吗？
lines.py: nǐ chí yī diǎn dá fù , shì gōng zuò hái méi jié shù de yuán gù ma ?
lines.en: Did unfinished work cause your later reply?

lines.zh: 她没来另有缘故，不是没有兴趣。
lines.py: tā méi lái lìng yǒu yuán gù , bù shì méi yǒu xìng qù .
lines.en: Her absence has another cause, not lack of interest.

lines.zh: 下次把约定写成到场时间，不只写下班时间。
lines.py: xià cì bǎ yuē dìng xiě chéng dào chǎng shí jiān , bù zhǐ xiě xià bān shí jiān .
lines.en: Next time state the agreed arrival, not just finishing work.

lines.zh: 我们按原来的约定见面。
lines.py: wǒ men àn yuán lái de yuē dìng jiàn miàn .
lines.en: We meet according to the original arrangement.

lines.zh: 我重新查看了周五的整段消息。
lines.py: wǒ chóng xīn chá kàn le zhōu wǔ de zhěng duàn xiāo xī .
lines.en: I checked the full Friday exchange again.

lines.zh: 她查看地图，才发现入口变了。
lines.py: tā chá kàn dì tú , cái fā xiàn rù kǒu biàn le .
lines.en: She checked the map and found the entrance had changed.

lines.zh: 此前我一直记成两点，所以先到了。
lines.py: cǐ qián wǒ yì zhí jì chéng liǎng diǎn , suǒ yǐ xiān dào le .
lines.en: Before this I had remembered two, so I arrived first.

lines.zh: 此前的记录没有包括最后那一天。
lines.py: cǐ qián de jì lù méi yǒu bāo kuò zuì hòu nà yī tiān .
lines.en: The earlier record excluded the final day.

lines.zh: 我想先把此事说清，不翻出所有旧争论。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān bǎ cǐ shì shuō qīng , bù fān chū suǒ yǒu jiù zhēng lùn .
lines.en: I want to clarify this matter first without reopening every old argument.

lines.zh: 他说明了此事的经过。
lines.py: tā shuō míng le cǐ shì de jīng guò .
lines.en: He explained how this matter unfolded.

lines.zh: 表面上是半小时，真正难受的是以为被放下不管。
lines.py: biǎo miàn shàng shì bàn xiǎo shí , zhēn zhèng nán shòu de shì yǐ wéi bèi fàng xià bù guǎn .
lines.en: On the surface it is half an hour; the hurt is feeling abandoned.

lines.zh: 表面上两个安排相同，负责的人不同。
lines.py: biǎo miàn shàng liǎng gè ān pái xiāng tóng , fù zé de rén bù tóng .
lines.en: The arrangements look the same, but the people responsible differ.

lines.zh: 我们想长久来往，不能每次都靠猜。
lines.py: wǒ men xiǎng cháng jiǔ lái wǎng , bù néng měi cì dōu kào cāi .
lines.en: We want a lasting friendship, not guesses on every occasion.

lines.zh: 这个办法能不能长久用，还要看时间。
lines.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ néng bù néng cháng jiǔ yòng , hái yào kàn shí jiān .
lines.en: Whether this approach can last depends on availability.

lines.zh: 我采纳了她提前写清时间的建议。
lines.py: wǒ cǎi nà le tā tí qián xiě qīng shí jiān de jiàn yì .
lines.en: I adopted her suggestion to state the time ahead.

lines.zh: 他听过意见，但没有全部采纳。
lines.py: tā tīng guò yì jiàn , dàn méi yǒu quán bù cǎi nà .
lines.en: He heard the suggestions without adopting them all.

lines.zh: 她那时不便看手机，并不是故意不理。
lines.py: tā nà shí bù biàn kàn shǒu jī , bìng bù shì gù yì bù lǐ .
lines.en: It wasn’t convenient for her to look at her phone then, not deliberate ignoring.

lines.zh: 如果不便来，可以早点告诉我。
lines.py: rú guǒ bù biàn lái , kě yǐ zǎo diǎn gào sù wǒ .
lines.en: If coming is inconvenient, you can tell me early.

lines.zh: 我想解释，不料那句话又让她生气了。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng jiě shì , bù liào nà jù huà yòu ràng tā shēng qì le .
lines.en: I wanted to explain, but that sentence unexpectedly upset her again.

lines.zh: 我们以为快到了，不料走错了门。
lines.py: wǒ men yǐ wéi kuài dào le , bù liào zǒu cuò le mén .
lines.en: We thought we were close, but unexpectedly went to the wrong entrance.

lines.zh: 真有急事，可以拨打电话，别只等消息。
lines.py: zhēn yǒu jí shì , kě yǐ bō dǎ diàn huà , bié zhǐ děng xiāo xī .
lines.en: For something urgent, you can call instead of only waiting for a message.

lines.zh: 她拨打了通知上的号码。
lines.py: tā bō dǎ le tōng zhī shàng de hào mǎ .
lines.en: She called the number on the notice.

lines.zh: 我想冷静，他偏在这时候又提一次。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng lěng jìng , tā piān zài zhè shí hòu yòu tí yī cì .
lines.en: I wanted to calm down, but he brought it up again just then.

lines.zh: 别人说先等，他偏要马上走。
lines.py: bié ren shuō xiān děng , tā piān yào mǎ shàng zǒu .
lines.en: Others said to wait, but he insisted on leaving immediately.

lines.zh: 他回复时，我恰好已经走到小厅。
lines.py: tā huí fù shí , wǒ qià hǎo yǐ jīng zǒu dào xiǎo tīng .
lines.en: When he replied I had just reached the hall.

lines.zh: 这张纸恰好放得进盒子。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhǐ qià hǎo fàng de jìn hé zi .
lines.en: This sheet fits just right in the box.

lines.zh: 我特意早点来，想先把桌子摆好。
lines.py: wǒ tè yì zǎo diǎn lái , xiǎng xiān bǎ zhuō zi bǎi hǎo .
lines.en: I came early specially to arrange the tables.

lines.zh: 她特意给我留了一个座位。
lines.py: tā tè yì gěi wǒ liú le yī gè zuò wèi .
lines.en: She deliberately saved a seat for me.

lines.zh: 我亲眼看见她到了，没有看到她前面的路程。
lines.py: wǒ qīn yǎn kàn jiàn tā dào le , méi yǒu kàn dào tā qián miàn de lù chéng .
lines.en: I saw her arrive myself, not her earlier journey.

lines.zh: 他亲眼看见门关了。
lines.py: tā qīn yǎn kàn jiàn mén guān le .
lines.en: He saw the door close himself.

lines.zh: 没收到答复时，我仿佛觉得只有自己在等。
lines.py: méi shōu dào dá fù shí , wǒ fǎng fú jué de zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ zài děng .
lines.en: Without a reply I felt as if I alone was waiting.

lines.zh: 灯光让窗外仿佛亮了一点。
lines.py: dēng guāng ràng chuāng wài fǎng fú liàng le yī diǎn .
lines.en: The light makes outside the window seem a little brighter.

lines.zh: 解释清楚以后，我不再坚持说他每次都迟到。
lines.py: jiě shì qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , wǒ bù zài jiān chí shuō tā měi cì dōu chí dào .
lines.en: After clarification I no longer insisted he was late every time.

lines.zh: 她不再每天翻那封信。
lines.py: tā bù zài měi tiān fān nà fēng xìn .
lines.en: She no longer rereads that letter daily.

lines.zh: 那天我不怎么想聊天，只想先把安排弄清楚。
lines.py: nà tiān wǒ bù zěn me xiǎng liáo tiān , zhǐ xiǎng xiān bǎ ān pái nòng qīng chǔ .
lines.en: I wasn’t very keen to chat that day; I wanted to clarify the arrangement first.

lines.zh: 她不怎么喝咖啡，常常选茶。
lines.py: tā bù zěn me hē kā fēi , cháng cháng xuǎn chá .
lines.en: She doesn’t drink much coffee and often chooses tea.

lines.zh: 等待本身已经让她累了，后来又听到很重的话。
lines.py: děng dài běn shēn yǐ jīng ràng tā lèi le , hòu lái yòu tīng dào hěn zhòng de huà .
lines.en: The waiting itself had tired her, before the harsh remarks.

lines.zh: 这句话本身没有写到场时间。
lines.py: zhè jù huà běn shēn méi yǒu xiě dào chǎng shí jiān .
lines.en: The sentence itself gives no arrival time.

lines.zh: 我们没有核对以前的次数，就说成每次。
lines.py: wǒ men méi yǒu hé duì yǐ qián de cì shù , jiù shuō chéng měi cì .
lines.en: We said every time without checking how many earlier occurrences there were.

lines.zh: 练习次数多了，不等于每次都练对。
lines.py: liàn xí cì shù duō le , bù děng yú měi cì dōu liàn duì .
lines.en: More practice sessions don’t mean every one was correct.

lines.zh: 我们挨着桌子坐，把手机放在中间一起看。
lines.py: wǒ men āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhōng jiān yì qǐ kàn .
lines.en: We sat beside the table with the phone between us to check together.

lines.zh: 这两把椅子挨着，不是隔着整个房间。
lines.py: zhè liǎng bǎ yǐ zi āi zhe , bù shì gé zhe zhěng gè fáng jiān .
lines.en: These chairs are next to each other, not across the room.

lines.zh: 那天我下班以后走去小厅，原来预计两点半到。周五收到邀请时，我把两点才能离开公司、还要半小时写在同一条回复里，也问可以吗。看到好，我就当作两个人已经约好两点半。我没有再把这个时间单独写一遍，也不知道她的日历里记的是两点。我们各自觉得已经说清，却依赖了不同的重点。
lines.py: nà tiān wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu zǒu qù xiǎo tīng , yuán lái yù jì liǎng diǎn bàn dào . zhōu wǔ shōu dào yāo qǐng shí , wǒ bǎ liǎng diǎn cái néng lí kāi gōng sī , hái yào bàn xiǎo shí xiě zài tóng yī tiáo huí fù lǐ , yě wèn kě yǐ ma . kàn dào hǎo , wǒ jiù dàng zuò liǎng gè rén yǐ jīng yuē hǎo liǎng diǎn bàn . wǒ méi yǒu zài bǎ zhè gè shí jiān dān dú xiě yī biàn , yě bù zhī dào tā de rì lì lǐ jì de shì liǎng diǎn . wǒ men gè zì jué de yǐ jīng shuō qīng , què yī lài le bù tóng de zhòng diǎn .
lines.en: I expected 2:30 arrival after work. My Friday reply combined finishing at two, half-hour travel and asking whether that worked. Her okay seemed agreement on 2:30; I didn’t repeat it and didn’t know her calendar said two. We each felt clear while relying on different details.

lines.zh: 两点五分她发消息时，我正在走路，没有马上打开手机。十二分在路口停下，我才看见，回说在路上，估计两点半。我不是故意让她等答复，也没有想到她已经一个人准备了那么久。收到每次都迟到，我一下觉得自己的安排被全部否定：明明已经说明，还被说成每次。我也回了很重的一句，说她从没认真看。
lines.py: liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn tā fā xiāo xī shí , wǒ zhèng zài zǒu lù , méi yǒu mǎ shàng dǎ kāi shǒu jī . shí èr fēn zài lù kǒu tíng xià , wǒ cái kàn jiàn , huí shuō zài lù shàng , gū jì liǎng diǎn bàn . wǒ bù shì gù yì ràng tā děng dá fù , yě méi yǒu xiǎng dào tā yǐ jīng yī gè rén zhǔn bèi le nà me jiǔ . shōu dào měi cì dōu chí dào , wǒ yī xià jué de zì jǐ de ān pái bèi quán bù fǒu dìng : míng míng yǐ jīng shuō míng , hái bèi shuō chéng měi cì . wǒ yě huí le hěn zhòng de yī jù , shuō tā cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn .
lines.en: Walking delayed my 2:05 message check until stopping at 2:12. I replied with the estimate, not deliberately withholding a response or knowing her preparation time. “Always late” felt like denying the arrangement I’d explained, and I replied with an equally harsh “never reads carefully.”

lines.zh: 到场以后，我首先想证明时间没有错。我把消息给她看，话说得快，她一提等待，我就打断。那时候我以为只要她看见两点半，问题就结束了。不料她更生气，说我连她最难受的地方都不听。我后来想，记录可以解决约定里写了什么，不能替一个人解释等待时怎么想，也不能让我随便把她的感受删掉。
lines.py: dào chǎng yǐ hòu , wǒ shǒu xiān xiǎng zhèng míng shí jiān méi yǒu cuò . wǒ bǎ xiāo xī gěi tā kàn , huà shuō de kuài , tā yī tí děng dài , wǒ jiù dǎ duàn . nà shí hòu wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yào tā kàn jiàn liǎng diǎn bàn , wèn tí jiù jié shù le . bù liào tā gèng shēng qì , shuō wǒ lián tā zuì nán shòu de dì fāng dōu bù tīng . wǒ hòu lái xiǎng , jì lù kě yǐ jiě jué yuē dìng lǐ xiě le shén me , bù néng tì yī gè rén jiě shì děng dài shí zěn me xiǎng , yě bù néng ràng wǒ suí biàn bǎ tā de gǎn shòu shān diào .
lines.en: On arrival I wanted proof of the correct time and interrupted her waiting account. I thought the 2:30 message would end the issue, but she felt unheard. A record establishes wording, not another person’s experience, and doesn’t license dismissing it.

lines.zh: 我们把手机放在桌上，轮流指着看。她承认漏看后面的半小时，我才慢慢平静下来。她问两点五分没回复的缘故，我把走路、停下看手机的过程说了。她没有亲眼看到那段，只能听我的解释；我也没有看见她一个人在小厅时怎么想。各自有自己的经历，也有看不到的部分，不是谁能拿出一条消息，就拥有整个下午。
lines.py: wǒ men bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō shàng , lún liú zhǐ zhe kàn . tā chéng rèn lòu kàn hòu miàn de bàn xiǎo shí , wǒ cái màn màn píng jìng xià lái . tā wèn liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn méi huí fù de yuán gù , wǒ bǎ zǒu lù , tíng xià kàn shǒu jī de guò chéng shuō le . tā méi yǒu qīn yǎn kàn dào nà duàn , zhǐ néng tīng wǒ de jiě shì ; wǒ yě méi yǒu kàn jiàn tā yī gè rén zài xiǎo tīng shí zěn me xiǎng . gè zì yǒu zì jǐ de jīng lì , yě yǒu kàn bù dào de bù fèn , bù shì shéi néng ná chū yī tiáo xiāo xī , jiù yōng yǒu zhěng gè xià wǔ .
lines.en: Checking together calmed me when she acknowledged missing the travel time. I explained walking and stopping; neither of us had witnessed the other’s whole experience. A message didn’t give either ownership of the entire afternoon.

lines.zh: 我说没有答应两点到，这句话本身可以核对。但我说她从没认真看，就没有同样的依据。我想到以前她记得我忘了带的东西，也提醒过活动地点，明显不是从没。我没有把这些例子拿来反过来证明她每次都认真，只是收回原来的总说法。关于过去的次数，要真讨论就一件一件看，不在生气的时候随口补成全部。
lines.py: wǒ shuō méi yǒu dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào , zhè jù huà běn shēn kě yǐ hé duì . dàn wǒ shuō tā cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn , jiù méi yǒu tóng yàng de yī jù . wǒ xiǎng dào yǐ qián tā jì de wǒ wàng le dài de dōng xi , yě tí xǐng guò huó dòng dì diǎn , míng xiǎn bù shì cóng méi . wǒ méi yǒu bǎ zhè xiē lì zi ná lái fǎn guò lái zhèng míng tā měi cì dōu rèn zhēn , zhǐ shì shōu huí yuán lái de zǒng shuō fǎ . guān yú guò qù de cì shù , yào zhēn tǎo lùn jiù yī jiàn yī jiàn kàn , bù zài shēng qì de shí hou suí kǒu bǔ chéng quán bù .
lines.en: Not promising two is checkable; “never reads carefully” isn’t supported in the same way. She’d remembered forgotten things and venues before. Those examples invalidate never without proving always. Past frequency requires specific review, not emotional universal wording.

lines.zh: 她说特意早到，是想一起准备，不只是按表等一个数字。我才想到，自己虽然预计两点半，也可以先问那之前需要多少准备。如果她确实需要两点一起做，我可能不能参加同一安排，可以改地点、改分工，或者直接说这次不便。我写可以吗，是一个问题；她回好，是答复，却没有把双方需要的全部事情都展开。
lines.py: tā shuō tè yì zǎo dào , shì xiǎng yì qǐ zhǔn bèi , bù zhǐ shì àn biǎo děng yī gè shù zì . wǒ cái xiǎng dào , zì jǐ suī rán yù jì liǎng diǎn bàn , yě kě yǐ xiān wèn nà zhī qián xū yào duō shao zhǔn bèi . rú guǒ tā què shí xū yào liǎng diǎn yì qǐ zuò , wǒ kě néng bù néng cān jiā tóng yī ān pái , kě yǐ gǎi dì diǎn , gǎi fēn gōng , huò zhě zhí jiē shuō zhè cì bù biàn . wǒ xiě kě yǐ ma , shì yī gè wèn tí ; tā huí hǎo , shì dá fù , què méi yǒu bǎ shuāng fāng xū yào de quán bù shì qíng dōu zhǎn kāi .
lines.en: She’d come early for joint preparation. I could have asked what was needed before 2:30. If two was essential, we might change place, responsibilities or acknowledge my unavailability. The question and okay didn’t unpack every preparation need.

lines.zh: 后来我们分别道歉。她说每次迟到那句太重，我也收回从没认真看，想到上一次，她还问了我两遍在哪里见。说完这些，我们都安静了一会儿。桌上的照片还没拍，她先把纸拿出来，我打开相机。她问要不要先看窗边的光，我说好，跟着她走过去，终于不用两个人一直站在门口说刚才谁怎么想。
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ men fēn bié dào qiàn . tā shuō měi cì chí dào nà jù tài zhòng , wǒ yě shōu huí cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn , xiǎng dào shàng yī cì , tā hái wèn le wǒ liǎng biàn zài nǎ lǐ jiàn . shuō wán zhè xiē , wǒ men dōu ān jìng le yī huì er . zhuō shàng de zhào piān hái méi pāi , tā xiān bǎ zhǐ ná chū lái , wǒ dǎ kāi xiàng jī . tā wèn yào bù yào xiān kàn chuāng biān de guāng , wǒ shuō hǎo , gēn zhe tā zǒu guò qù , zhōng yú bù yòng liǎng gè rén yì zhí zhàn zài mén kǒu shuō gāng cái shéi zěn me xiǎng .
lines.en: We both apologised. She withdrew 'late every time'; I withdrew 'never read carefully,' remembering that last time she'd checked where to meet twice. We were quiet for a moment. She took out the paper and I opened the camera. Shall we check the window light? Yes. We could finally move from the doorway and begin, rather than keep discussing what we'd thought.

lines.zh: 周四的安排我们写成六点到小厅，五点半再确认。她看着我的日历，提醒我别只记下班的时间，我就在六点后面加了到小厅四个字。路上真有变化，我会再给一个大概时间；着急就打电话，不方便接的时候稍后回。她说这样就能知道先做什么，又把自己要带的东西列在旁边，让我拍下来别忘。
lines.py: zhōu sì de ān pái wǒ men xiě chéng liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǔ diǎn bàn zài què rèn . tā kàn zhe wǒ de rì lì , tí xǐng wǒ bié zhǐ jì xià bān de shí jiān , wǒ jiù zài liù diǎn hòu miàn jiā le dào xiǎo tīng sì gè zì . lù shàng zhēn yǒu biàn huà , wǒ huì zài gěi yī gè dà gài shí jiān ; zháo jí jiù dǎ diàn huà , bù fāng biàn jiē de shí hou shāo hòu huí . tā shuō zhè yàng jiù néng zhī dào xiān zuò shén me , yòu bǎ zì jǐ yào dài de dōng xi liè zài páng biān , ràng wǒ pāi xià lái bié wàng .
lines.en: We entered Thursday six at the hall, confirming at 5:30. Looking at my calendar, she reminded me not to note just my finish time, so I added 'arrive at the hall.' I'd update the estimate if travel changed; we'd call urgently and reply later when unable to answer. That let her plan what to do first. She listed what she was bringing and told me to photograph it.

lines.zh: 拍照片的时候，她还是比较安静。我差点又问是不是还没原谅，话到了嘴边，先咽了回去。她已经把周四记在日历里，现在问这个只会让她再说一遍。最后一张拍好，她走过来看，说这张光不错。我把照片发给她，又把椅子放回墙边。出门时她说周四见，我回了好，提醒自己五点半先发消息。
lines.py: pāi zhào piàn de shí hou , tā hái shi bǐ jiào ān jìng . wǒ chà diǎn yòu wèn shì bú shì hái méi yuán liàng , huà dào le zuǐ biān , xiān yàn le huí qù . tā yǐ jīng bǎ zhōu sì jì zài rì lì lǐ , xiàn zài wèn zhè gè zhǐ huì ràng tā zài shuō yī biàn . zuì hòu yī zhāng pāi hǎo , tā zǒu guò lái kàn , shuō zhè zhāng guāng bù cuò . wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi tā , yòu bǎ yǐ zi fàng huí qiáng biān . chū mén shí tā shuō zhōu sì jiàn , wǒ huí le hǎo , tí xǐng zì jǐ wǔ diǎn bàn xiān fā xiāo xī .
lines.en: She was still quiet during the photographs. I almost asked if she hadn't forgiven me, then held back; asking would only make her repeat herself. After the last shot she came over: the light was good. I sent it and put the chair back. At the door she said see you Thursday. I agreed, reminding myself to message at 5:30.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我把新时间放在自己的日历里，写清到场，不是离开。我也保留周五的那段交流，没有拿它去向别的朋友证明她这个人从来不好。它帮助我们核对一次约定，不该变成不断在别人面前讲她失误的材料。我们还会有记不准的时候，希望下一次先问清具体内容，再决定那句话到底是在说一次，还是被自己说成了所有次数。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ xīn shí jiān fàng zài zì jǐ de rì lì lǐ , xiě qīng dào chǎng , bù shì lí kāi . wǒ yě bǎo liú zhōu wǔ de nà duàn jiāo liú , méi yǒu ná tā qù xiàng bié de péng you zhèng míng tā zhè gè rén cóng lái bù hǎo . tā bāng zhù wǒ men hé duì yī cì yuē dìng , bù gāi biàn chéng bù duàn zài bié ren miàn qián jiǎng tā shī wù de cái liào . wǒ men hái huì yǒu jì bù zhǔn de shí hou , xī wàng xià yī cì xiān wèn qīng jù tǐ nèi róng , zài jué dìng nà jù huà dào dǐ shì zài shuō yī cì , hái shi bèi zì jǐ shuō chéng le suǒ yǒu cì shù .
lines.en: I entered arrival explicitly and retained the Friday exchange to check an arrangement, not use it to denigrate her to others. Future uncertain recollections can be examined specifically before one occasion becomes every occasion.

questions.q: What does the other perspective add?
choices: Correct wording can coexist with missed needs and harsh replies
Correct timing excuses every interruption
A message gives one person the whole afternoon’s experience

questions.q: What next time is entered into the calendar?
choices: Thursday six at the hall
Thursday six finishing work with unspecified arrival
Saturday two with no other condition

questions.q: Why not demand instant proof of complete forgiveness?
choices: A changed arrangement and continued contact can precede complete emotional recovery
Quietness proves permanent hatred
All feelings disappeared when the photo session began
questions.answer: A changed arrangement and continued contact can precede complete emotional recovery

lines.py: dào chǎng yǐ hòu , wǒ shǒu xiān xiǎng zhèng míng shí jiān méi yǒu cuò . wǒ bǎ xiāo xī gěi tā kàn , huà shuō de kuài , tā yī tí děng dài , wǒ jiù dǎ duàn . nà shí hòu wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yào tā kàn jiàn liǎng diǎn bàn , wèn tí jiù jié shù le . bù liào tā gèng shēng qì , shuō wǒ lián tā zuì nán shòu de dì fāng dōu bù tīng . wǒ hòu lái xiǎng , jì lù kě yǐ jiě jué yuē dìng lǐ xiě le shén me , bù néng tì yī gè rén jiě shì děng dài shí zěn me xiǎng , yě bù néng ràng wǒ suí biàn bǎ tā de gǎn shòu shān diào .
lines.en: On arrival I wanted proof of the correct time and interrupted her waiting account. I thought the 2:30 message would end the issue, but she felt unheard. A record establishes wording, not another person’s experience, and doesn’t license dismissing it.

audio.zh: 周五晚上六点，我问陈宇第二天下午能不能两点到小厅，一起给活动拍照。他十分钟以后回复，说两点才能下班，从公司过去要半小时，大概两点半到，问可不可以。我当时还在收东西，只看见前面两点，又觉得他已经答应，就回了好，到时联系。后来我把日历记成两点，没有再看后面那一段。
audio.py: zhōu wǔ wǎn shang liù diǎn , wǒ wèn chén yǔ dì èr tiān xià wǔ néng bù néng liǎng diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , yì qǐ gěi huó dòng pāi zhào . tā shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu huí fù , shuō liǎng diǎn cái néng xià bān , cóng gōng sī guò qù yào bàn xiǎo shí , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , wèn kě bù kě yǐ . wǒ dāng shí hái zài shōu dōng xi , zhǐ kàn jiàn qián miàn liǎng diǎn , yòu jué de tā yǐ jīng dā yìng , jiù huí le hǎo , dào shí lián xì . hòu lái wǒ bǎ rì lì jì chéng liǎng diǎn , méi yǒu zài kàn hòu miàn nà yī duàn .
audio.en: At six Friday evening I asked Chen Yu about arriving at the hall at two Saturday to take activity photos. Ten minutes later he said he finished work at two, needed half an hour and expected about 2:30, asking whether that worked. While packing I noticed two and took it as acceptance, replied okay and entered two without rereading.

tasks.statement: The Friday reply says work finishes at two and arrival is about 2:30.
tasks.why: The full reply includes the travel estimate.

audio.zh: 周六我特意提前到，想先把桌子和几件要拍的东西摆好。两点到了，他没来。两点五分我发消息问怎么还没到，等了几分钟没答复。我不知道他已经在走路，脑子里先想到的是他忘记了。两点十二分，他说在路上，估计两点半；我回了一句，你每次都迟到。这句话发出去以后，我还觉得自己是在说实话。
audio.py: zhōu liù wǒ tè yì tí qián dào , xiǎng xiān bǎ zhuō zi hé jǐ jiàn yào pāi de dōng xi bǎi hǎo . liǎng diǎn dào le , tā méi lái . liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn wǒ fā xiāo xī wèn zěn me hái méi dào , děng le jǐ fēn zhōng méi dá fù . wǒ bù zhī dào tā yǐ jīng zài zǒu lù , nǎo zi lǐ xiān xiǎng dào de shì tā wàng jì le . liǎng diǎn shí èr fēn , tā shuō zài lù shàng , gū jì liǎng diǎn bàn ; wǒ huí le yī jù , nǐ měi cì dōu chí dào . zhè jù huà fā chū qù yǐ hòu , wǒ hái jué de zì jǐ shì zài shuō shí huà .
audio.en: I came early Saturday to prepare. At two he was absent; my 2:05 message initially went unanswered. Not knowing he was walking, I assumed forgetfulness. At 2:12 he estimated arrival at 2:30. I sent “you’re late every time,” then felt it was simply truthful.

tasks.statement: The narrator knew Chen Yu was walking before the 2:05 question.
tasks.why: They did not know and assumed he had forgotten.

audio.zh: 我说没有答应两点到，这句话本身可以核对。但我说她从没认真看，就没有同样的依据。我想到以前她记得我忘了带的东西，也提醒过活动地点，明显不是从没。我没有把这些例子拿来反过来证明她每次都认真，只是收回原来的总说法。关于过去的次数，要真讨论就一件一件看，不在生气的时候随口补成全部。
audio.py: wǒ shuō méi yǒu dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào , zhè jù huà běn shēn kě yǐ hé duì . dàn wǒ shuō tā cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn , jiù méi yǒu tóng yàng de yī jù . wǒ xiǎng dào yǐ qián tā jì de wǒ wàng le dài de dōng xi , yě tí xǐng guò huó dòng dì diǎn , míng xiǎn bù shì cóng méi . wǒ méi yǒu bǎ zhè xiē lì zi ná lái fǎn guò lái zhèng míng tā měi cì dōu rèn zhēn , zhǐ shì shōu huí yuán lái de zǒng shuō fǎ . guān yú guò qù de cì shù , yào zhēn tǎo lùn jiù yī jiàn yī jiàn kàn , bù zài shēng qì de shí hou suí kǒu bǔ chéng quán bù .
audio.en: Not promising two is checkable; “never reads carefully” isn’t supported in the same way. She’d remembered forgotten things and venues before. Those examples invalidate never without proving always. Past frequency requires specific review, not emotional universal wording.

tasks.statement: Retracting never proves the opposite always.
tasks.why: Counterexamples reject never without proving always.

audio.zh: 周四的安排我们写成六点到小厅，五点半再确认。她看着我的日历，提醒我别只记下班的时间，我就在六点后面加了到小厅四个字。路上真有变化，我会再给一个大概时间；着急就打电话，不方便接的时候稍后回。她说这样就能知道先做什么，又把自己要带的东西列在旁边，让我拍下来别忘。
audio.py: zhōu sì de ān pái wǒ men xiě chéng liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǔ diǎn bàn zài què rèn . tā kàn zhe wǒ de rì lì , tí xǐng wǒ bié zhǐ jì xià bān de shí jiān , wǒ jiù zài liù diǎn hòu miàn jiā le dào xiǎo tīng sì gè zì . lù shàng zhēn yǒu biàn huà , wǒ huì zài gěi yī gè dà gài shí jiān ; zháo jí jiù dǎ diàn huà , bù fāng biàn jiē de shí hou shāo hòu huí . tā shuō zhè yàng jiù néng zhī dào xiān zuò shén me , yòu bǎ zì jǐ yào dài de dōng xi liè zài páng biān , ràng wǒ pāi xià lái bié wàng .
audio.en: We entered Thursday six at the hall, confirming at 5:30. Looking at my calendar, she reminded me not to note just my finish time, so I added 'arrive at the hall.' I'd update the estimate if travel changed; we'd call urgently and reply later when unable to answer. That let her plan what to do first. She listed what she was bringing and told me to photograph it.

tasks.statement: The new plan guarantees immediate calls at every time.
